thread:
sana: FYI Dedicated pool 'eu-west-2-rpc-4' is showing ~30% throughput drop since 09:10 UTC, some 503s and 1.2s p99. Customers reported timeouts. @alex_m
alex_m: On it, starting log grab. Which customer? sample req id?
sana: customer: acme-inc, req id: req_0a9f. I can repro via curl: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"gpt-x","input":"hello"}' --verbose
opsbot: Autoscaler event: pool eu-west-2-rpc-4 scaled to 2->2 at 09:12:23 (no scale up) :warning:
jordan: Telemetry: continuous_batcher avg_batch_tokens: 630 -> 1980, max_batch_tokens hitting configured cap 2048, scheduler quantum spiked. Prefill queue depth rose from 15->260.
alex_m: interesting — looks like small seqs are being batched into oversized token batches. That increases scheduling latency and causes prefill stalls.
mike_ops: Also noticed one tenant with very long seqs flooding the packer (tenant id tn-77), noisy neighbor pattern.
lina_support: Customers saw increased error 503s and some auth refresh errors around 09:11; not billing-related.
alex_m: quick mitigation: lowering max_batch_tokens to 1024 and bump prefill_concurrency to 6 on pool, rolling now.
deploybot: Started config rollout: pool eu-west-2-rpc-4 — max_batch_tokens=1024 prefill_concurrency=6 by alex_m, 09:20 UTC
jordan: After change avg_batch_tokens down to 720, queue depth stabilized. p99 latency improving but still ~450ms.
alex_m: Next step: add per-tenant packer_limit and enable tenant isolation for tn-77, and adjust scheduler quantum back to 8ms. Opening an incident doc.
sana: Good call. I'll update the support ticket and tell acme-inc we rolled config and we're monitoring :thumbsup:
mike_ops: Filing follow-up: run replay with heavy long-seq synthetic load and verify autoscaler triggers correctly.
opsbot: Incident created: INC-2026-423 — Eng-runtime oncall pinged @ops-sre
lina_support: I'll CC acme contact and monitor for any billing or token errors.
alex_m: closing for now, monitoring. If throughput dips again escalate to SRE. Thanks everyone.
